Mastering MCC Round 1 Choice Filling 2026: Your Gateway to a Medical Career

The dream of becoming a doctor or dentist begins with a crucial step: navigating the NEET UG counselling process. For aspirants of 2026, the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) Round 1 Choice Filling is a pivotal moment that determines your path to securing a coveted MBBS or BDS seat. Understanding this intricate process, from registration to locking your preferences, is key to a successful admission. This comprehensive guide is designed to empower you with the latest information and expert tips for MCC Round 1 Choice Filling 2026.

The MCC conducts the NEET UG counselling for 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats in government medical and dental colleges, 100% seats in Deemed/Central Universities, AIIMS, JIPMER, and ESIC institutes.

Key Dates for MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 (Round 1)

While official dates are subject to release on the MCC's website (mcc.nic.in), based on previous trends, here’s a tentative timeline to help you prepare:

✅ NEET UG 2026 Result: Expected June/July 2026.

✅ MCC Counselling Registration Start (Round 1): Tentatively July 21, 2026 (though some sources indicate early July).

✅ Round 1 Choice Filling & Locking: Expected late July 2026.

✅ Round 1 Seat Allotment Result: Anticipated 1st week of August 2026.

The entire counselling process, including subsequent rounds (Round 2, Mop-Up, and Stray Vacancy), is expected to conclude by October 2026.

Eligibility Criteria for MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026

Before you dive into choice filling, ensure you meet the fundamental eligibility requirements:

✅ You must have successfully qualified the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) UG 2026.

✅ You need to be registered on the official MCC website (mcc.nic.in) to participate.

✅ For All India Quota seats, Indian citizens are eligible without any domicile restrictions.

Step-by-Step Guide to MCC Round 1 Choice Filling

The choice filling process is arguably the most critical stage. Follow these steps meticulously:

1. Online Registration

Visit the official MCC website, mcc.nic.in. Click on the "UG Medical Counselling" link and then "New Registration." You will need to enter your NEET UG 2026 Roll Number, date of birth, and other personal details to create your counselling account. Make sure to save your user ID and password securely.

2. Payment of Counselling Fee

After registration, you'll be required to pay a non-refundable registration fee and a refundable security deposit. This fee varies based on your category and the type of institution (government or deemed university) you are applying for. Payment is typically made online via credit card, debit card, or net banking.

3. Accessing and Filling Choices

Once your registration and fee payment are successful, you can access the list of participating medical and dental colleges. Carefully select institutions and courses that align with your preferences and NEET rank.

4. Arranging and Modifying Choices

This is where strategic thinking comes in. Arrange your selected colleges and courses in your desired order of preference. The MCC portal usually allows you to drag and drop to reorder your choices. You can modify these choices multiple times before the final deadline.

5. Locking Your Choices

After finalizing your preferences, it is imperative to "lock" your choices before the stipulated deadline. You'll need to log in and click the 'lock choices' option. If you fail to lock them manually, your choices will automatically be locked on the last day. Remember, no modifications can be made after locking.

Crucial Tips for Smart Choice Filling 2026

Your choices significantly impact your seat allotment. Consider these expert recommendations:

✅ Prioritize Broadly: Start by listing your dream colleges, followed by moderate options, and then a few safe choices based on your NEET rank and previous years' cut-offs.

✅ Fill Maximum Choices: To maximize your chances, fill as many colleges and courses as you are genuinely willing to join. A wider selection can increase your opportunities for allotment.

✅ Research Thoroughly: Investigate colleges based on factors like academic quality, clinical exposure, infrastructure, faculty, and fee structure. Don't add any college you wouldn't want to join.

✅ Understand Upgradation: If you're allotted a seat you're not fully satisfied with in Round 1, you might have the option for upgradation in subsequent rounds. However, always remember that fresh choice filling is required for every round.

✅ Keep Documents Ready: Ensure all necessary documents like your NEET UG 2026 scorecard, admit card, academic certificates, ID proof, and category certificates are ready for verification.

Documents You'll Need

Be prepared with both original and photocopies of these essential documents for verification:

  • NEET UG 2026 Scorecard
  • NEET Admit Card 2026
  • Class 10th Marksheet and Certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
  • Class 12th Marksheet and Certificate
  • Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License)
  • Passport Size Photographs
  • Provisional Allotment Letter (after seat allotment)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable - SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)

The MCC Round 1 Choice Filling for 2026 is a critical phase for all NEET UG aspirants. By staying informed about the tentative dates, understanding the step-by-step process, and implementing smart choice-filling strategies, you can significantly enhance your chances of securing a seat in your desired medical or dental college. Keep an eye on the official MCC website (mcc.nic.in) for all the latest updates and notifications. Good luck!
